references.text: As a parallel to Jesus' submission and Mary's reflection, this verse shows the Holy Spirit coming upon Jesus and God's voice confirming him, which was also a significant moment preserved in memory.
This verse shows Solomon's submission under his parents, paralleling Jesus' submission under Mary and Joseph.
Paul urges children to obey their parents, which mirrors Jesus' example of submission.
This verse urges children to obey their parents in the Lord, reflecting Jesus' submission.
